PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.

3. When learning Holding Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools.

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

5. When learning Oblique Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Oblique Projection.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Oblique Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Oblique Projection.

6. When learning Self- Exploration and Career Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Self- Exploration and Career Development.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Self- Exploration and Career Development.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Self- Exploration and Career Development.

7. When learning Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

9. When learning Handling Waste Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Waste Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Waste Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Waste Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Handling Waste Materials.

10. When learning Wood, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Wood.

11. When learning Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.

12. When learning Safety on Raised Platforms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Safety on Raised Platforms.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety on Raised Platforms.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety on Raised Platforms.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Wood and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Handling Waste Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
